newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shareowners say positive on Skandia merger.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shareowners say positive on Skandia merger.

text.p: The Swedish Shareowners' Association said it was positive about a proposed merger between insurance company Skandia and mortgage bank Stadshypotek.

"The transaction appears to be market driven, financially and structurally correct. The advantages of a merger are considerable seen from Skandia's as well as Stadshypotek's point of view," the association, Aktiespararna, said in a statement.
It said the association had particularly noted the fact that "two competent and independent boards had together recommended the transaction."

Finance Minister Erik Asbrink, managing the disposal of the Swedish state's minority 34 percent stake in Stadshypotek, strongly criticised the board of the mortgage bank on Monday for allegedly failing to consult over the merger.
